name: mongodb-atlas
description: mongodb-atlas — MongoDB Atlas CLI. Manage Atlas clusters, databases, users, and network access from command line.

install_steps: curl -LO https://fastdl.mongodb.org/mongocli/mongodb-atlas-cli_1.39.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf mongodb-atlas-cli_1.39.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv atlas /usr/local/bin/ && rm -rf mongodb-atlas*
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.
